For `#beacon-chain-light-client-study-group`, here are two topics I suggest that we will tackle next. Feel free to ask questions here for us to find out together.
1. How does "header update" work? Understand what information is required for block header transition, what is the update mechanism
2. How could a client participat in the  "portal-network" to get the necessary data to complete the header update?
